annotation.title_clean: Report adopted pursuant to Article 112(1) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 on the need to review the list of prohibited AI practices and of high-risk AI systems listed in Annex III
annotation.title_en: Report adopted pursuant to Article 112(1) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 on the need to review the list of prohibited AI practices and of high-risk AI systems listed in Annex III
annotation.summary_en: The Commission's first annual review under Article 112(1) of the EU AI Act assesses whether to amend Article 5 prohibitions and Annex III high-risk use cases. Drawing on Member State input, a 547-response consultation and AI incident database analysis, it finds no immediate need to amend, but flags a possible gap on CSAM and non-consensual deepfakes and several areas for monitoring.
key_provisions_or_claims: No immediate need to amend Article 5 or Annex III given limited application time and lack of enforcement experience.
Potential regulatory gap identified: AI systems generating CSAM and non-consensual intimate deepfakes are not covered by Article 5.
Areas flagged for monitoring: AI companions and therapy chatbots, emotion recognition, dark patterns, point 5 of Annex III, debt collection, critical infrastructure.
Annex I product-based high-risk systems (e.g. medical devices, self-driving vehicles) are out of scope of the report.
Next Article 112 assessment due in 2026, coordinated with the AI Board and national authorities.
